shots.caption: Police chase down the palm-lined east road: 3 wanted stars, Mission 2 live, three cruisers closing in.
On foot at a city intersection: traffic rolling past, a pedestrian on the pavement, Mission 1 live.
Sunset Courier run: driving the east road toward the first package drop with the HUD and minimap live.
Title screen over the city at golden hour: Solmar Bay from above.
